turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Yaar, sabse pehle toh congratulations! 15 saal se tum dono jis din ka wait kar rahe the, woh finally aa gaya. Shreya aur tumhari dosti sach mein bohot pyaari hai.

Lekin main tumhara darr bilkul samajh sakti hoon. Roze mein energy levels low hote hain, aur Sangeet ki bhagam-bhag, rehearsals, aur stage par dance karna... sunkar hi darr lagna bilkul normal hai. Ek taraf best friend ka sapna hai aur dusri taraf tumhari physical limits. 

Par iska matlab yeh nahi ki tum nahi kar sakti! Isko thoda smart tarike se plan karte hain:

1. **Timing check karo:** Sangeet aam taur par shaam ko hi shuru hota hai. Kya tumhara opening dance Iftar ke baad schedule ho sakta hai? Agar tum khajoor aur paani peekar, thodi energy lekar stage par jao, toh bohot behtar feel karogi.
2. **Smart choreography:** Shreya aur choreographer se baat karo. Opening dance ko bohot zyada high-energy ya cardio-heavy rakhne ke bajaye thoda graceful, slow aur expressive banao. Kam mehnat mein zyada impact!
3. **Rehearsals ka dhyan rakho:** Shaadi se pehle ki rehearsals din mein karne ke bajaye Iftar ke baad ya bilkul early morning (Sehri ke aas-paas) rakho jab tum hydrated ho.

Shreya tumhari best friend hai, woh tumhari situation bilkul samjhegi. Usse khulkar baat karo aur kaho, "Main karungi zaroor, bas mujhe thodi tumhari help chahiye timing manage karne mein."

Tum kya sochti ho? Dance ka timing kya ho sakta hai wahan?

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Oh yaar... I can feel how heavy this must be for you. "Rassi jaisi" feel karna bohot hi exhausting aur painful hota hai, khaas kar tab jab dono taraf woh log hain jinhe tum sabse zyada pyaar karti ho. 

Dono apni-apni jagah se soch rahe hain, par beech mein tum pis rahi ho. 

Pehle **Shreya** ki baat karte hain: Tumne bilkul sahi kaha, woh buri nahi hai, bas use sach mein ahsaas nahi hai ki ek roza chhodna tumhare liye kitni badi baat hai. Non-muslims ke liye kabhi-kabhi yeh samajhna mushkil hota hai ki roza sirf ek 'diet' ya 'fast' nahi hai, balki ek gehri spiritual commitment hai. Tumhe use pyaar se, par bohot clear shabdon mein samjhana hoga: *"Shreya, main tumhare liye stage par aag laga dungi, par roza rakh kar. Roza chhodna mere liye option nahi hai, aur main chahti hoon tum meri is spirituality ka respect karo."*

Ab **Ammi** ki baat: Unka darr bhi unki jagah natural hai. Ramzan ibadat ka mahina hai, aur unhe lag raha hai ki sangeet ka shor-sharaba is paak mahine ke dhyan ko bhatka dega. Unhe thoda calm karna hoga. Unse kaho: *"Ammi, main apne roze aur ibadat mein koi kami nahi aane dungi. Par Shreya meri 15 saal purani dost hai, agar main uske sabse khushi ke din par thodi der uske saath khadi nahi hui, toh mera dil wahan atka rahega. Main bas apna dosti ka farz nibha kar turant wapas aa jaungi."*

Tumhe in dono ke beech ek "bridge" banna padega. Tumhe kya lagta hai, agar tum dono se alag-alag, akele mein baith kar thodi dil se baat karo, toh kya woh tumhara point samajhne ki koshish karenge?

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Yaar, main bilkul samajh sakti hoon ki tum is waqt kitni exhausted ho. Jab stress hadd se zyada badh jata hai, toh dimaag sabse pehle 'escape route' hi dhoondta hai. Yeh sochna bilkul natural hai, aur main tumhe iske liye bilkul judge nahi kar rahi. 

Lekin sach kahun? Tumhe abhi yeh jhooth ek aasan rasta lag raha hai, par baad mein yeh tumhare dil par bohot bhari padega. 

15 saal ki dosti hai yaar. Tum dono ne bachpan se is din ke sapne dekhe hain. Jab shaadi ho jayegi, aur tum uski videos dekhogi, ya jab Shreya tumse baat karegi, toh kya tumhare dil mein ek tees nahi uthegii ki tum wahan nahi thi? Aur jhooth ka ek boojh hamesha dosti ke beech reh jata hai.

Aunties aur unke sawaalon ka darr bilkul valid hai, par unka kya hai? Unhe toh har cheez par bolna hota hai. Tumhe kisi ko koi explanation dene ki zaroorat nahi hai ki tum kyun nahi kha rahi ya kyun sunset ka wait kar rahi ho. Roza rakhna tumhari choice hai aur isme sharam kaisi?

Main tumse yeh nahi keh rahi ki tum poori raat wahan ruko aur sab jhelo. Ek beech ka raasta nikaalte hain — **"Hit and Run" policy!**

Tum sangeet mein jao, bas us opening dance ke liye. Shreya ke saath stage share karo, use gale lagao, aur uske baad chupke se nikal aao. Na tumhe kisi aunty ko jhelna padega, na poori raat wahan rukna padega, aur tumhara roza aur ibadat bhi disturb nahi hogi. 

Abhi tum bohot thaki hui ho, isliye koi bada decision mat lo. Thodi der gehri saans lo. Kya "kam waqt ke liye jaana" is jhooth se behtar option nahi lag raha?

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Tumne jo yeh "seene mein pathar" wali baat kahi na, usne mere dil ko chhu liya. Main samajh sakti hoon ki yeh darr kitna gehra hai. Jab do sabse pyaari cheezein — tumhara deen aur tumhari sabse purani dosti — aamne-saamne khadi ho jayein, toh lagta hai jaise dono mein se kisi ek ko chunna hi padega, aur dono hi suraton mein nuksaan tumhara hi hoga.

Par meri baat dhyan se suno: **Tum sad story nahi banogi.** 

Yeh takraav tab tak hi hai, jab tak tum isko ek 'fight' ki tarah dekh rahi ho. Agar tum ise thoda alag nazariye se dekho, toh tumhara deen tumhe mohabbat, dosti nibhana aur rishton ki qadar karna sikhata hai. Aur tumhari dosti tumhare is deen ka aadar karna seekh rahi hai. Yeh dono cheezein ek dusre ke khilaf nahi hain, yeh dono hi tumhare dil ka hissa hain.

Tumhari shaadi ki photos mein koi daag nahi lagega. Jab tum 10 saal baad woh album dekhogi, toh tum muskuraogi aur sochogi, *"Dekho, main kitni thak gayi thi, par maine apne roze ki maryada bhi rakhi aur apni jaan-se-pyaari dost ke chehre par muskurahat bhi laayi."* Yeh ek sad story nahi, balki tumhari dosti aur tumhare sabse khubsoorat aur mature roop ki kahani banegi.

Apne seene se woh pathar hata do, yaar. Tum bohot pyaari ho, aur tumhara dil dono ke liye kaafi bada hai. Tum dono ko sambhal logi. 

Chalo, ek gehri saans lo. Abhi ke liye bas itna socho ki tum Shreya ke paas jaogi, uske haath pakadkar thodi der baithogi, aur use pyaar se samjhaogi. Tumhe kya lagta hai, kya tumhara yeh sach sunkar woh tumhara saath nahi degi?
